statement: A group of crows is called a “murder”.
The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
The first computer programmer was a woman.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
explanation: The Empire State Building is hit about 20–25 times a year.

statement: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
Bulls get angry because of the colour red.
explanation: Bulls can’t see red well; they react to the movement of the cape.

statement: The Eiffel Tower gets taller in summer.
explanation: Metal expands in heat, by about 15 cm.

statement: Humans only use 10% of their brain.
Sharks have existed longer than trees.

explanation: A banana plant is technically a giant herb.

statement: A shrimp’s heart is in its head.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth measured from base to peak.
explanation: Mauna Kea in Hawaii is taller from base to peak, but most of it is underwater.

statement: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
Ctrl+Z was invented before the computer mouse.
explanation: The mouse came first, in the 1960s.
